stem: A scouting team reports that pest counts doubled this week, but the route also changed and twice as many plants were inspected. What is the strongest conclusion?
choices: The apparent increase cannot be interpreted confidently until sampling effort and route are standardized or normalized
The new route proves the treatment failed
Negative findings from last week should be discarded
rationale: Scouting is a measurement system. Changes in route or effort can change observed counts independently of true pest pressure, so comparable methods are required for trend interpretation.
